readOrder.purpose: Brand context, content fundamentals, and visual foundations — read first for design intent
Skill entry point and quick essentials
Structured token understanding source — read to understand color, type, spacing, radius, and motion values
Runtime CSS variables — link into HTML

notes: css.json is the token understanding source; colors_and_type.css is the runtime link source.
Preview DOM/CSS is the first source for component fidelity; component JSON provides intent and evidence notes.
Light theme is default; .dark overrides semantic aliases for the inverse footer and dark surfaces.
The system is monochrome by default; colored semantic statuses are not promoted without source evidence.
No source-site images or font files are bundled; previews and the UI Kit use local CSS and inline primitives only.
